page.layout: One printed page. Running head across the top with page number 13 at upper right. Main text in a single block of full-width lines at the top, then a large woodcut of a fish (Scarus) with an initial S and text wrapping on its left, then a second fish woodcut with caption "Merula Rondeletij" and a narrow italic column at lower left beside a third fish woodcut; a "B" signature at lower right. Notes in the left margin: none beyond the narrow italic column, which is a column of text.

Dente, alij Sargo, alij Cantheno uocant, à nostris piscatoribus pro Sargo uenditur.
GERM. In Oceano Germanico an reperiatur hic piscis nondum mihi constat.
(Scarum quidem uarium in Oceano non capi Bellonius testatur.) quamobrem nomen eius
Germanicum fingo: ein Mewer oder Mewling: id est Ruminator: ein
tis etiā aliis piscibus est com-
partim ex nigro, caeruleum est: squamae ueluti notis obscurioribus asperfae. In medio uentris
notas duas purpureas habet: formosissimus sane piscis, si quis alius. Romae
per semestre spatium unus tantum mihi usus est. Capitur aliquādo in nostro mari, e regione
Magalone, & nō procul à Masilia, & Antipoli: circa Stoechades insulas saepius. ¶ Bellonius superioris
non meminit: & hunc simpliciter Scarum nominat. Nullus (inquit) est in Propontide, Ponto, &
Hellesponto: in Creta plurimus. ¶ Piscem corporis forma Scaro uario similem, totum purpurei
coloris, Rondeletius tertiam Anthiae speciem facit. Vide infrà in hoc Ordine.
GRAECVM in Creta vulgus hodieq; antiquam appellationem retinuit, Bellonius.

CANARIARVM insularum incolae, ut ferunt, Brechos appellant, Rondeletius.
GERM. In Oceano reperitur circa Canarias: forte & alibi: quanquam
Bellonius in Oceano reperiri negat: de Gallico nimirū Oceano tantum sentiens. Nomen fingemus,
ein Puntermew ling, hoc est, Ruminator uarius: uel circunscribemus, ein schöner geteilter Mewer.

page.notes: Scattered marks in the margins; the woodcut figures of fish (Scarus, Merula, a third fish) are not transcribed. The narrow italic column at lower left is main text. The fish caption "Merula Rondeletij." is set above the second figure and is given as a foot line. Uncertain: "Sanbrachsmen", "Puntermew", "Coracino" and "Tinçam" read from the scan with doubt.
